specific_objectives: 2.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to enumerate roles of Air Arm of the Indian Navy and introduce about IN aircrafts, its roles and operating squadrons/ flights.

practical: Review of Squadron Logbooks and Aircraft Maintenance Records
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the Indian Navy Air Arm?
Name one major naval air station in India.
How are naval aircraft squadrons typically designated?

development.content:
Introduction to Naval Air Squadrons
Types of Aircraft Operating
Roles of Naval Aviation
Key Locations of Squadrons
Operational Readiness Standards

Specific Roles of Helicopters
Fixed Wing Aircraft Capabilities
Squadron Deployment Patterns
Maintenance and Support Roles
Integration with Fleet Operations

Future Aircraft Procurement
Training and Conversion Programs
Safety Protocols in Squadrons
Career Paths in Naval Aviation
Review of Current Fleet Status

summary_questions: Explain the difference between a flight and a squadron in naval aviation.
Identify the primary role of the HAL Tejas in the Indian Navy.
Describe how squadrons are deployed for fleet operations.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the location and aircraft types of one naval air station to be discussed in the next lesson on Air Stations/Aviation Establishments.
